en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Abdullah Al Barqy, from one of our companions, raising it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The people (performers) of the acts of kindness, they are the people of the acts of kindness in the Hereafter. It would be said to them: ‘Your sins have been Forgiven for you, so you can gift your good deeds to whomsoever you so desire to’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from abu ‘Abd Allah al-Barqiy from certain individuals of our people in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

providers of Benevolent Assistance will be as such on the Day of Judgment also. They will receive the news, ‘Your sins are all forgiven. You may give away your good deeds as gifts to whomever you like.”’
